target.statement: For every fixed finite agent-site index set and every admissible standard-Borel two-channel datum with normalized private priors, normalized likelihood kernels, normalized positive source rows, lagged transported source laws, and the stated absolute-continuity and finiteness conditions, prove that the tied-replica construction defines a normalized generative joint independent of the current recognition law and that its unit-temperature negative ELBO equals the joint-typed lagged unit-coefficient two-channel scalar F_JT,h^{lag,1} plus the state-model mutual-information correction; prove exact equality with this joint-typed scalar under state-model mean field and prove invariance under the declared simultaneous fiber-coordinate pushforwards.
target.quantifiers: For every nonempty finite agent-site set A, every finite source set in each active relational channel, and every collection of standard-Borel probability data satisfying the declared normalization, measurability, absolute-continuity, and finiteness hypotheses.
domains: A nonempty finite agent-site set A; the number of agents N is fixed and finite.
Standard-Borel private state spaces K_a, model-parameter spaces M_a, and observation spaces O_a.
Finite nonempty source-label sets J_a^q and J_a^s for active relational channels; an empty peer set means the channel is omitted.
Probability laws p_a and r_a, lagged transported source laws u_ab^n and v_ab^n, source rows pi_a^q and pi_a^s, likelihood kernels L_a, and recognition laws zeta_a, beta_a, and gamma_a.
codomains: A normalized finite product generative law conditional on the stored history H_n.
An extended-real negative ELBO on the tied-replica recognition family.
A finite joint-typed lagged unit-coefficient two-channel scalar plus an explicit nonnegative correction.
target.regularity: All kernels are measurable and normalized. Chosen fixed-observation likelihood-density representatives are positive on the admitted recognition support, and every displayed KL and log-likelihood expectation is finite unless the extended-value convention is invoked.
measures: Declared probability priors p_a on K_a and r_a on M_a.
Declared observation reference measures nu_a with likelihood densities ell_a(o_a|k,m).
Counting measure over the finite agent-site set; no continuum cell weights occur in the exact theorem.
boundary_conditions: No spatial boundary condition is needed for the finite probabilistic identity; any later lattice boundary sector is outside this theorem.
symmetries: Simultaneous measurable bijective coordinate changes on state and model fibers, with priors, recognition laws, transported sources, transport maps, and likelihood densities pushed forward consistently.
Relabeling of the finite agent-site and source-label sets.
target.equivalence: ELBO identities are literal for the chosen fixed-observation density representatives. The joint-typed scalar uses the joint private observation expectation under zeta. Gauge statements compare simultaneously pushed-forward laws. The tied-replica lift is not declared ontologically identical to a one-latent-variable model, and equality to the literal PIFB2 observation display is not part of this target.
premises: The stored history H_n, including q^n, s^n, and the transports, is conditioned on and fixed during the n+1 recognition update.
The current recognition law does not enter the generative law except through fixed declared model parameters already contained in H_n.
The relational latent copies are distinct random variables whose recognition marginals are tied to the private marginals as a restriction of the variational family.
modeling_postulates: The private and relational replicas represent distinct informational roles of the same displayed agent belief and generative-model state.
permitted_theorems: Finite-product normalization and Tonelli's theorem for nonnegative kernels.
The KL chain rule for finite mixtures and product references.
Invariance of relative entropy under measurable bimeasurable bijections.
Finite-horizon iterated-kernel construction on standard-Borel spaces.
target.falsification_criterion: An admissible datum for which the proposed joint is not normalized, the displayed Radon-Nikodym expansion into F_JT,h^{lag,1} plus mutual information fails, the mean-field correction does not vanish, or a declared simultaneous pushforward changes the scalar refutes the corresponding universal conjunct.
target.literature_policy: Use the live Research PIFB2 manuscript and exact-ELBO crosswalk only to record project typing and the unresolved literal-observation comparison. The mathematical certificate is the self-contained derivation in this run; no equality to the literal manuscript display, novelty claim, or priority claim is part of the target.
